avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces darunavir plasma concentrations by ~50%, leading to treatment failure and resistance development
avoid_supplements.action: Absolutely contraindicated; counsel patient to avoid completely

avoid_supplements.name: Garlic Supplements (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may significantly reduce darunavir levels
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose supplemental garlic; culinary amounts acceptable

avoid_supplements.name: Rifabutin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer decreases darunavir exposure; concurrent use with darunavir/ritonavir not recommended without dose adjustment
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use alternative TB treatment; if essential, requires clinical monitoring and possible dosing adjustment

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May induce CYP3A4 at high doses, potentially reducing darunavir levels
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously and monitor viral load; maintain consistent dosing

caution_supplements.name: Milk Thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: Possible mild CYP3A4 induction may slightly reduce darunavir bioavailability
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for therapeutic efficacy; generally acceptable at standard doses

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases darunavir exposure, raising risk of toxicity and adverse effects
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit and grapefruit juice; substitute with other citrus fruits

caution_foods.name: High-Fat Meals
caution_foods.mechanism: Fat increases darunavir bioavailability; inconsistent fat intake may cause variable absorption
caution_foods.action: Maintain consistent dietary fat intake with meals; darunavir should be taken with food for optimal absorption

monitoring_notes: Darunavir is a potent CYP3A4 substrate requiring careful management of enzyme inducers and inhibitors. Monitor viral load, CD4 count, and hepatic function periodically, especially when adding new supplements or medications.
